target: AArch64 PCI QEMU, one vCPU, graphical desktop and VirtIO keyboard
verified: A generated function returned 42 in the initial focused QEMU probe, and a separate probe used multiple StreamPrint calls plus a generated nested #exe block to define constants whose sum was 42.
On the final kernel, StreamPrintDefineChecks verified generated definitions through guest Define(), a DefinePrint update, and a guest-only shadow taking priority over the compiler entry.

The bundle contains the byte-identical pinned DefineStr source, with the prior bootstrap workaround removed. Its graphical output showed Acme Inc, a numeric age, and a time; the terminal then evaluated 40+2 as 42 and zstatus reported failed=0.
The static ARM64 source overlay check and QEMU/Pi builds passed.
limits: The final demo run used XTalk after an earlier graphical typing attempt dropped characters; it does not establish reliable long-command keyboard input.

The port now executes simple #exe statements individually; see exe-statement-order-qemu-2026-11-09.json. Full control-flow lookahead, nested, exception, concurrency, AOT and formatting semantics are not established.
TimeIns, live UTM and physical Pi behavior remain unverified.
